# Restaurant Table Reservation System (RTRS)

> Multi-tenant restaurant and salon reservation SaaS operated by Vibespot Technologies Ltd. (Ghana). Built with Node.js + Express + Sequelize + MySQL backend and Vue 3 + TypeScript + Vite frontend. Supports WhatsApp-first ordering, Paystack payments (GHS), ShaQ Express delivery, and Ghana-localized legal compliance. Single-tenant by default; multi-tenant platform code is gated behind `TENANT_MODE=enabled`.

## Agent Instructions

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Project conventions, verification commands, recommended skills, and critical constraints (do not commit unless asked, do not reintroduce NOT NULL/PARTITION BY on `tenantId`, always sync Obsidian vault, refresh this file on architecture shifts).

## Obsidian Integration

- **Vault path**: `/Users/kjsanni/Developments/macho/Restaurant Reservation System`
- **Plugin**: [obsidian-with-kilocode](https://github.com/realhenrylan/obsidian-with-kilocode) bridges the vault with KiloCode CLI.
- **Skills**: `.kilo/skills/` inside the vault — AI skill definitions as markdown files, auto-loaded by the plugin.
- **Sessions**: `.kilocode/sessions/` inside the vault — conversation history persisted with the vault.
- **MCP config**: `.kilocode/mcp.json` inside the vault — MCP server definitions for the plugin.
- **Plugin settings**: Managed in Obsidian Settings → KiloCode; CLI config is read from `~/.config/kilo/kilo.jsonc`.
